description: For every jointly partial recursive family \(\psi_n(x)\), there is one \(p\) with \(\varphi_p(\langle n,x\rangle)\simeq\psi_n(x)\) for all \(n,x\); the exact compiler \(c(n)=s(p,n)\) is primitive recursive and satisfies \(\varphi_{c(n)}(x)\simeq\psi_n(x)\). No coverage assumption on the family is needed.
